assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: pose-specific 2D VTuber expression source painting. Input Image 1 is the EXACT edit target, not a loose style reference. Return a single full portrait with exactly the same 1122 x 1402 canvas, framing, subject scale and registration as this image. Keep this same approved short blue-gray tomboy-haired, mint-eyed anime character with head turned toward image left and gently lifted, chin up. Change ONLY the eyelid expression and inner mouth opening. Relax BOTH upper eyelids halfway down for a natural half blink. Keep a visibly open slit and the SAME mint iris centers and gaze; the upper lid moves down over the same iris, lower eyelid and inner/outer eye corners stay where they are. Both eyes follow the tilted perspective eye axis of this exact portrait, far eye remains narrower. Open the mouth a SMALL amount: a thin, soft dark inner-mouth opening about 15–20 source pixels tall, with subtle muted pink lower interior. Keep exactly the same restrained smile width and corner locations.
Upper-lip invariance is critical: the original mouth center is approximately (405, 577) on the 1122 x 1402 source canvas. Keep the upper lip/mouth seam TOP CENTER at this original point. The opening must grow DOWNWARD from this point, not float upward, not move sideways. Follow the exact current mouth-line tilt and foreshortening; do not use a frontal mouth template. Keep nose, nose-to-upper-lip distance, lower-face plane and chin outline fixed. Do NOT move the jaw/chin silhouette to create the opening. This is a restrained drawn mouth, not painted lipstick.
Preserve ALL other details exactly: eyebrow shape/location, every hair strand and bang overlap, skull and face outline, nose, ears, skin color/shading, blush, highlights, neck, shoulders, jacket, shirt and background. No eyebrow action, no expression-induced head movement, no new accessories, no cat ears, no text, no panel grid, no border. Flat illustration color and fine line art identical to the reference. The two eyelid edits and mouth edit will later be cropped separately at native resolution; no reframing or global restyling.

processing: Six full-portrait source paintings copied unchanged from the built-in image tool. Runtime selects independent fixed-size eye and mouth crops on each approved pose. No mirrored reuse, stretch, rotation or dynamic patch repositioning. Eye/skin/hair boundaries and upper-lip registration are measured separately for each pose.
limitations: 斜上闭眼稿带轻微笑意，低头稿更接近垂睑，尚未分开中性生理眨眼和开心闭眼。
三个固定斜向姿态：左斜上、右斜上、左斜下；不包含右斜下或正面纯俯仰，不代表连续转头。
每姿态各两张新源稿，分离眼嘴裁切后提供睁/半闭/闭眼和闭/小/大张嘴三档，没有中间帧。
仅支持 eyeBlinkLeft、eyeBlinkRight、jawOpen、mouthClose。俯仰姿态的独立视线、眉动作、噘嘴、抿嘴与移嘴尚未制作。
低头中性眼裂与视线属于已批准姿态原画的一部分，未把下视基线重新定义为居中视线。
局部保留源稿肤色和画出的发丝，尚无独立前景头发层；上唇仅按测得点作固定平移配准，动态不改变尺寸或位置。
不同姿态只供独立观察；每次切换回中性，躯干差异未经连续动作配准。
